title: Tigers vs leopards in India
caption:
India has roughly four leopards for every tiger.

Madhya Pradesh leads both counts, with an estimated 785 tigers and 3,907 leopards in 2022.

Sources: NTCA & WII, Status of Tigers, Co-predators and Prey in India 2022; Status of Leopards in India 2022. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
